content.short: DEX Finance is a DAO that offers an ecosystem of financial products.
content.description: DEX Finance is a DAO offering yield-generating, auto-compounded investment strategies and non-custodial crypto-management protocols. The project features a product lineup including DEX Money Market, dexIRA, dexETF, and dexVAULTS, aimed at delivering long-term investment solutions while simplifying advanced trading strategies. Its team combines software engineers, marketing professionals, trading experts, and legal specialists, collectively bringing over 40 years of experience in technology-based businesses.
